read.thesis: Record adjusted EPS of $2.85 ex-notables (+22%) on higher variable investment income and volume growth, but a life insurer with no capacity or pricing read; GAAP net income lifted by derivative gains.

triggers.label: Adjusted EPS ex-notables up 22%
triggers.quote: Adjusted earnings per share up 22% to $2.85, excluding total notable items — highest-ever quarter for MetLife.

triggers.label: Adjusted PFOs ex-PRT up 8%
triggers.quote: Adjusted PFOs, excluding pension risk transfers (PRT), 8% to $13.5 billion — with growth in all six business segments.

guidance.metric: Free cash flow ratio and direct expense ratio
guidance.quote: On track to deliver against free cash flow ratio and direct expense ratio targets for the year.

red_flags.label: GAAP EPS flattered by derivative gains
red_flags.quote: Net derivative gains amounted to $551 million after tax, driven by gains on embedded derivatives associated with ceded reinsurance
